mapper.sql: p.id, p.tenant_id, p.create_user_id, p.create_time, p.update_user_id, p.update_time, p.deleted_at, p.version, p.resource_id, p.enabled, p.score_threshold, p.min_samples, p.evaluation_window_seconds, p.max_iterations, p.cooldown_seconds, p.auto_publish, p.judge_enabled, p.optimizer_model_alias, p.judge_model_alias, p.optimizer_instruction, p.state, p.iterations_done, p.consecutive_failures, p.last_evaluated_at, p.last_evaluated_version_id, p.last_average_score, p.last_sample_count, p.active_run_id, p.converged_at

SELECT , v.version_no AS last_evaluated_version_no FROM ddc_ai_optimization_policy p LEFT JOIN ddc_ai_version v ON v.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND v.resource_id = p.resource_id AND v.id = p.last_evaluated_version_id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM ddc_ai_optimization_policy p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM ddc_ai_optimization_policy p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.enabled = true AND p.state IN ('ARMED', 'AWAITING_PUBLISH') AND p.active_run_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.last_evaluated_at ASC NULLS FIRST, p.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
SELECT p.resource_id FROM ddc_ai_optimization_policy p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.judge_enabled = true ORDER BY p.resource_id
mapper.update: UPDATE ddc_ai_optimization_policy SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', version = version + 1, update_user_id = #{et.updateUserId}, update_time = #{et.updateTime} WHERE tenant_id = #{et.tenantId} AND id = #{et.id} AND version = #{et.version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
